name: lounge-deploy
description: Build a static Lounge upload ZIP locally and validate it against the latest Let's Coding policy without uploading source files or ZIP bytes.

interface.shortDescription: Build and validate static Lounge upload ZIPs
interface.longDescription: Analyze a single HTML, static web, Vite, or Next.js project; make only the minimum static-export changes; build and inspect the output locally; and use the current Let's Coding policy for final manifest validation and a Korean completion report. Source files, ZIP bytes, environment values, and credentials are not sent to the MCP server. Actual Lounge upload is not included.
